title: Console ops catchup: flags, telemetry, and rollout dry-run
content:
Meeting: Console ops catchup (sprint bridge)
Date: 2027-03-15 10:00-10:30 PT
Attendees: Aisha (host), Noah, Diego, Sofia, Laura, + Ad-hoc: Priya (SRE)

Summary / goal:
Quick alignment on three threads before the canary push tomorrow: feature-flag gating, telemetry coverage for key metrics, and fallback/runbook sanity checks. Lightweight decisions and owners; defer deep engineering scoping to follow-ups.

Notes by topic:
1) UI - rollout UX and flicker investigation
 - Observed: intermittent quick DOM flicker on panel load when flag toggles, repro in Chrome but not Safari. Reported in beta (5% rollout).
 - Suspect: race between deferred module init and new flag-based CSS class change.
 - Immediate mitigation: Noah to push small debounce (50ms) on flag inversion logic behind debug flag. Deploy to beta today.
 - Long term: refactor panel mount sequence in ticket CONSOLE-4821. Diego to scope refactor (owner + ETA end of sprint).
 - UX note: Sofia to add microcopy explaining rollout behavior for affected users (tooltips) — helps reduce support noise.

2) Rollouts - canary metrics and rollback criteria
 - Canary plan: gradual 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% across regions over 24h with automated checks at each step.
 - Success metrics (must pass at each gate): 95th perc latency not increased by >20ms, error rate delta <0.5pp, RU (render updates) success ratio >99.5%.
 - Observability hooks: need trace correlation id in rollout logs (currently missing for new client SDK).
 - Action: Priya (SRE) to add temporary event transformer in ingestion to map client_request_id -> trace_id for the canary window. Work start: today, done before first gate.
 - If metrics violate: automated rollback to last stable and trigger page on PagerDuty team console-rollouts. Confirmed with on-call rotation.

3) Analytics / Telemetry gaps
 - Telemetry-309 (missing event for panel-primary-button click in lazy-loaded panel) still open. Product needs that event to compute adoption rate for the feature.
 - Laura to add event with version and flag metadata; ensure schema validated in telemetry repo (PR referenced above).
 - Immediate test: add synthetic event generator in staging to validate pipeline and dashboard refresh. Sofia will run validation tests and post screenshots to the Slack thread.
 - Dashboard: new canary dashboard (rollout-canary-2027-03-15) created but missing error breakdown by region. Diego to add region dimension to the error chart (small query tweak).

Blockers and risks:
 - Blocker: client SDK release is late; without the new SDK we lose trace propagation for some mobile clients. Impact: partial blindspots for errors. Mitigation: flag mobile clients out of the canary cohort; Aisha to coordinate with SDK team.
 - Risk: analytics lag in ingestion could delay gate decisions. Contingency: use synthetic probes and SRE aggregated logs as fallback for first gate.

Action items (owner — due):
 - Noah — push debounce hotfix to beta (2027-03-15 EOD) — if repro persists, revert to stable UI.
 - Diego — scope panel mount refactor and create CONSOLE-4821 sub-tasks (2027-03-19).
 - Priya (SRE) — implement temporary ingestion mapping for client_request_id->trace_id (2027-03-15 before 14:00 PT).
 - Laura — add analytics event and open PR to telemetry schema (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/78) (2027-03-16).
 - Sofia — run telemetry validation on staging and post evidence in Slack (2027-03-15).
 - Aisha — coordinate with SDK team to opt-out mobile clients from canary if SDK not ready (2027-03-15 12:00 PT).

Open questions / follow-ups:
 - Do we have an agreed TTL for temporary ingestion mappings? (Priya to propose; aim <48h).
 - Decide on rollback messaging to customers and in-app banner copy (product + comms). Sofia to draft and loop in product PM.
 - Should we add a synthetic user journey probe that exercises panel flows end-to-end? (High value for future canaries). Priya + Diego to prototype next sprint.

Quick wins / observations:
 - Small debounce resolved a separate flaky e2e test locally — good sign.
 - Canary dashboard template reusable for future feature rollouts; keep pattern in docs repo.

Next sync: brief check-in tomorrow 09:15 PT before first canary gate (10-15 min).

Notes to self (informal):
 - Keep canary gates strict for first 24h — better safe than noisy rollouts.
 - Remember to update the runbook with the trace mapping short-term step and how to revert it.

References and useful links:
 - CONSOLE-4821 (refactor ticket)
 - TELEMETRY-309 (missing event)
 - PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1259, https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/78
 - Slack thread: #console-rollouts (link above)

End of notes.
